content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge relies on Matthew 1:16 alone failing to state a verdict in either direction as a reason for UNDERDETERMINED.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"UNDERDETERMINED -- the passive egennēthē states no verdict on the begetter in either direction, and the defender answered Luke 1:27, Luke 2:4 and Numbers 1:2 in [CR2] section A.3 and [CR3]; the verb change is real [L1]/[L2] but neither text's own words state the other reading's contrary.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.","room":"none","why":"The judge uses the single verse's non-statement of either side as the basis for UNDERDETERMINED, which K-S2 forbids."}
